entities.summary: Kim Dae, a notable figure in the history of South Korea, associated with Asian Financial Crisis and Sunshine Policy (1998–2008). Preceded by Sunshine Policy and Inter-Korean Summit and IMF Crisis. Their legacy influenced First Inter-Korean Summit — Kim Dae-jung meets Kim Jong-il in Pyongyang and PSY's 'Gangnam Style' becomes the first YouTube video to reach 1 billion views.
